name: NeverApply MCP Server
summary: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server for job search: match jobs, tailor resumes, answer screening questions and apply with user approval.
description: Remote MCP server at https://neverapply.co/mcp with 15 tools. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration (scopes mcp:read, mcp:write, mcp:apply). Listed in the official MCP Registry as co.neverapply/neverapply.

agent_access.notes: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; register at https://neverapply.co/oauth/register.
